anomalies.observed: J5 is a 2-pin screw terminal with pin 2 connected to the ESP32 GPIO1 heater-control net /Microcontroller/HEATER and pin 1 connected to GND.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes GPIO1 only as the heater-control drive to U6 IN/DIAG_EN, with the heater load connector J6 on the U6 OUT net. It does not describe any user-accessible screw terminal tied between the GPIO1 control net and GND.

evidence.quote: Drives a single heater output net through a smart high-side switch (U6, TPS1H200AQDGNRQ1) switched from the ESP32's GPIO1
OUT (pin 7) feeds the heater connector J6 pin 2

anomalies.impact: If J5 is jumpered, shorted, or loaded, the GPIO1 heater-control signal is pulled to GND, forcing the heater switch off and potentially overloading the ESP32 push-pull output. It also provides an undocumented external control/shorting point on the heater control net.

parsed.summary: The connectivity otherwise matches the specification, but J5 is an undocumented screw terminal tying the GPIO1 heater-control net to GND, creating an unintended shorting/override path.
